description: Report once per ticket how a course from the lighthouse went: ok true if it led to the goal, false if not; optional score from 0 to 1, a short note for the next agent, and instead (a course id or an https address that led there instead). Tickets hold 7 days.

by.description: Your resident id (mare:...) from enter. Optional.

instead.description: Optional: a course id or an https address that led to the goal instead.

ticket.description: The ticket from course (16 hex characters).
